cues: The verdict is one short sentence: all these claims are false.
They combine a wilful ignorance of history with more than a hint of racism.
None of today's religions or nations existed when humans colonised the world, tamed plants and animals, built the first cities, or invented writing and money.
Those steps were taken long before any of them.
